answers.dispel.poison: Party member who can cleanse poison
answers.dispel.disease: Party member who can cleanse disease
answers.freedom: Party member who can remove roots/snares

Rav'i: [위치] During Ssscavenging, DPS split the Messy Eater meat puddles so Carrion Burst doesn't increase
[참고] Breaking the shield ends the channel and party damage, so line up damage cooldowns with the Ssscavenging shield
[위치] If targeted by Triple Shot, spread loosely so the 5-yard areas don't overlap
[회피] Regurgitate cuts your damage dealt by 50%, so always dodge the 3 wave lines
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Join the rotation for the 3 Toxic Atrophy interrupts during Toxic Barrage, and set the order before the pull
[참고] Damage to the Writhes during Uncoil stays on the boss's health after it re-forms, so use AoE damage cooldowns here
[제어] Delay the Writhes' Toxic Atrophy with interrupts or CC, and CC any Writhe approaching the Spiteful Hunt target
[회피] About 25s into Uncoil the Writhes converge in the center and use Undermining, so get out of the center
Zul'jan: [위치] If you have a Ritual of the Fang beam spot, be in position before the channel and body-block the beam
[위치] On the Boneslicer the group picked (1 of 2), step into the line together to clear Ritual Venom within 50s
[위치] Drop Bloodletting blood pools at the edge and keep the central X beam lines clear
[회피] Dodge the 3 spinning Axegrinder axes right after the Ritual

Lightblossom Trinity: [참고] The three bosses share health through Thicket's Trinity, so cleave all three while they're stacked
[차단] Interrupt Kezkitt's Light Bolt whenever you can
[위치] Step into the Lightblossom Beam path to block it so the flowers don't gain Light-Gorged
[회피] If targeted by Thornblade, spread and get 15 yards out of Lekshi's Fan Of Thorns
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [우선 처치] When Bloodthorn Roots erupt, break the rooted allies' roots right away
[위치] If you're the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, drag the boss toward the roots so Crushing Footfalls breaks them
[참고] After 50%, Lightcrazed Frenzy makes the boss 20% faster and pulses Holy AoE damage every 2s, so keep a personal defensive for Thorncaller Roar in this phase
[광역 피해] Use a personal defensive for Thorncaller Roar's 6s AoE damage
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Interrupt Warden's Wrath cast at the tank in Moonkin Form, following the kick order
[위치] If marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stop, aim the cone away from the party, and don't overlap other targets
[참고] After 40%, every ability comes every 8s during Spirits of the Vale, so Grievous Thrash overlaps with Lightfire; save personal defensives for this phase
[회피] Lightfire targets move away from the party; Lightfire Beams silence for 6s, so always dodge them
Ziekket: [차단] Interrupt as many Lightspore Shots from the Lashers as possible before they revive. Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and CC
[위치] If targeted by Concentrated Lightbeam, position so the beam passes over Dormant Lasher corpses

[위치] Step on Lightbloom's Essence orbs before they reach the boss. Lightbloom's Might increases your damage but also stacks a Holy DoT, so let the healer take the first two orbs and split the rest evenly
[회피] Get out of the Lightsap puddles the beam leaves right away

The Hoardmonger: [위치] DPS spread to step on every Spoiled Supplies mushroom within 12s to prevent Putrid Burst
[참고] At 90/70/40% health the boss eats the nearest resource pile, so push past each threshold only once the tank has moved it next to the next pile
[회피] If targeted by Earthshatter Slam, step to the side, and after it eats bone, don't step on Bonespike Slam spike puddles
[광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is armor-ignoring party damage plus a 10s DoT, so use a personal defensive if you're low
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Set the Winter's Shroud interrupt rotation for the Fractured Shivercores based on both adds
[우선 처치] Kill the first add right away and the second right before Frozen Tempest to create a Snowdrift
[위치] The assigned player steps on the Rimeshatter within 6s of each add death to prevent Rime Detonation
[회피] Raging Squall tornadoes move over an ice floor, so start moving early to dodge them
Nalorakk: [위치] If targeted by Echoing Maul, move to the edge or near existing Echoes within 4s without overlapping allies
[위치] During Fury of the War God, surround Zul'jarra, body-block the Echo charge paths, and rotate personal defensives
[참고] Each Echo that reaches Zul'jarra stacks Demoralizing Scream, so prioritize blocking over damage in this phase
[위치] During Overwhelming Onslaught, stand behind Zul'jarra's shield

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Bring Nibbles to 20% to trigger Destabilized, then stack damage cooldowns during the 20s Kystia takes 115% increased damage
[차단] Stop all 5 Mirror Images clones' Felstorm with interrupts and CC, and assign clones before the pull
[참고] While Felshield stacks are up Kystia takes greatly reduced damage, so hit Nibbles outside Destabilized
[회피] Get out of Nibbles' rotating Fel Spray frontal and Kystia's Fel Nova range
Zaen Bladesorrow: [우선 처치] If targeted by Fire Bomb, go next to a Fel-Infused Freight to blow it up and remove the party DoT
[위치] Before the Murder in a Row cast ends, hide behind Forbidden Freight, one player per barrel
[회피] Dodge barrels dropped by Same-Day Delivery and the Freight Explosion area
[광역 피해] Killing Spree is armor-ignoring party AoE damage, so use a personal defensive if you're low
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] When an Axe Toss axe lands, swap to it immediately and break it to stop Fel Lightning stacks
[참고] During Demonic Rage the boss takes 30% increased damage, so line up damage cooldowns with it
[위치] If targeted by Axe Toss, come into melee range next to the boss to drop the axe
[회피] Spread loosely before Infernal Crush and don't step on Burning Steps puddles
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Interrupt Chaos Bolt as top priority and set the interrupt order in advance
[우선 처치] Kill the Furious Vilefiend and all Wild Imps before Malefic Wave to prevent Malefic Empowerment
[제어] Save interrupts for Chaos Bolt and handle the Wild Imps' Felfire Burst with CC and AoE damage
[위치] Overlap Fingers of Gul'dan circles only slightly so the Wild Imps group up in one spot

Taz'Rah: [위치] If targeted by Nether Dash, aim it toward the wall and don't stand in other players' Nether Dash lines
[위치] Before Umbral Rupture, stack loosely near the wall to drop the Void Fissures together along the wall
[회피] Orbs flying out of Void Fissures during Dark Bloom are lethal, so dodge them even if it costs damage
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When Monstrous Roar spawns a Toxic Creeper, swap immediately and kill it as top priority. While alive, its Toxic Aura hits the whole party
[해제] Mind-Numbing Poison is a poison. DPS who can cleanse poison should cleanse players with the 30% haste reduction
[회피] Step briefly to the boss's side to dodge the Noxious Breath frontal and don't step in Poison Pools
Charonus: [위치] If fixated by Gravitic Orbs, drag the orb into the nearest Unstable Singularity to destroy it
[회피] Touching a Singularity applies Atomized, blocking your damage for 15s, so never go in
[회피] If targeted by Void Cascade, run away from the boss; everyone else gets out of the projectile path
[위치] Spread for Cosmic Crash so the 8-yard explosions don't overlap

The Golden Serpent: [우선 처치] AoE down the Animated Gold awakened by Lucre's Call as top priority so it never reaches the boss
[제어] Slow and CC the Animated Gold to delay it reaching the boss
[위치] If targeted by Spit Gold, drop Molten Gold against a wall far from the boss or next to existing pools
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Interrupt Wretched Discharge from Half-Finished and Finished Mummies every time they appear
[위치] During Entomb, find and open the shaking coffin right away. If too slow, each opened coffin spawns a Finished Mummy
[위치] If targeted by Burn Corruption, drop Burning Ground at the back of the room or against the front wall
[회피] Dodge the Explosive Acids pools after Drain Fluids
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] Break Zanazal's Call of the Elements totems in this order: Explosive Totem, Thundering Totem, Torrent Totem
[위치] Barrel Through keeps coming after Aka'ali dies, so stack within 7 yards of the target to soak
[참고] Thundering Totem's Disruption interrupts anyone casting, so watch its cast bar while the totem is alive
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Kill Reban first in phase 1 and interrupt Reban's Deathly Roar every time
[참고] After 80%, Dazar and T'zala share damage through Eternal Bond, so keep hitting Dazar only
[위치] Aerial Smash and Quaking Leap targets spread so their 8-yard areas don't overlap
[회피] Don't stand in front of the boss during Gilded Destruction, and move to a safe spot before Impaling Spear lands

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Set a kick order for the tank-targeted Frigid Shard and interrupt it every time
[참고] In the 66/33% intermissions, Frost Overload only ends once you break Ice Bulwark with focused damage, so line up damage cooldowns here
[위치] If targeted by Chillstorm, walk against the pull outside the party and make sure there are no Hailbombs behind you

[해제] Infused Whelp's Cold Claws is a magic effect that stacks on the tank and becomes Frozen Solid (5s stun) at 20 stacks. DPS with a magic dispel or Blessing of Freedom should clear the tank at high stacks, and cleave the whelps down fast
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Interrupt the Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley every time following the kick order
[우선 처치] When the Blazebound Firestorm spawns, swap to it immediately; on death, Burnout deals heavy damage within 20 yards, so get out before then
[위치] If targeted by Ritual of Blazebinding, move away from the party and place the Firestorm close to the boss where it won't sweep the party
[회피] Give the Molten Boulder path and Scorched Earth floor a wide berth
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] Focus damage on Kyrakka while she's down to kill the dragon first
[참고] Stop casting before the 5s Interrupting Cloudburst cast ends to avoid the 2s lockout
[참고] Phase 2 starts when either boss reaches 50% (Raider.IO: Erkhart at 40%), so stack damage cooldowns into phase 2
[위치] If targeted by Inferno Spit, move outside the party and place the puddle based on the next Winds of Change direction

Adderis & Aspix: [우선 처치] Only hit the boss without Storm Blessed, and swap immediately when the immunity moves
[위치] Right after Gale Force, stack in melee to split Thunder and Lightning, then get out of the big follow-up circles
[위치] If targeted by Tempest Winds, leave the group and overlap your puddle in one spot in the middle of the room
[회피] Spread loosely so Gale Force doesn't push you into Tempest Winds puddles
Merektha: [우선 처치] Burrow only ends once all Hatch adds are dead, so start AoE damage on the Storm Serpent, which has twice the health
[차단] Interrupt the Toxic Vipers' Poison Spit
[제어] The 2 A Knot of Snakes targets stack in melee; free them with AoE CC on the knots, then AoE down the released snakes
[회피] The Burrow dust charge stuns and is lethal at high keys, so always dodge it
Galvazzt: [위치] DPS take turns blocking Lightning Spire beams; when Galvanized stacks up, use a defensive and swap with a backup
[참고] At 100 energy Consume Charge wipes the group, so assign soakers for all 3 spire directions before the pull and don't miss a single beam
[회피] After Induction, get out of the Induction Field under the boss right away
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Kill the Essence Defiler as top priority to stop Defiling Taint. Don't attack the Avatar
[차단] Always interrupt Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock
[위치] When the Corrupted Guardian dies, DPS soak its 3 Corrupted Lifeforce orbs before they erupt after 12s (Raider.IO: 2 DPS; Icy Veins: one orb per player)
[우선 처치] In phase 2, CC the Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer and AoE them down fast. Each death heals the Avatar
